about: Register a business or self-employed person for VAT with the Federal Tax Authority.
note: Requirements read from the official FTA service page on the checked date. FTA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. VAT registration. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Mandatory when taxable supplies and imports pass AED 375,000 in 12 months or are expected to within 30 days
Voluntary above AED 187,500 of supplies, imports or taxable expenses
Applies to people doing business in the UAE even without a trade licence
Apply within 30 days of becoming required to register
documents: Certificate of incorporation, memorandum or partnership agreement, if applicable
Commercial registration or licence and branch licences
Emirates ID and passport of owners and authorised signatories
Power of attorney for signatories, if applicable
Signed and stamped declaration of taxable supplies and monthly sales
Contracts, invoices or purchase orders as supporting evidence
PDF only, up to 15 MB per file
timing: FTA processes a complete application in 20 business days
channels: EmaraTax platform, sign in with UAE PASS
